title: When the Sigil Falls Revisited
author: Ulyana Galloway
blurb: Astrid Kavanagh, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
